Sales Representative Job at Samhays Limited




        
    

        
        Samhays Limited (SHL) has been a leader in the Automobile Paint Industry for over 35 years.  Our aim is to always provide our customers with the best products and services. We are equipped with the resources and technical expertise needed to make your vehicle look like a brand new vehicle. We work hard to maintain our reputation of excellent customer service.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Sales Representative

Job Location: Ajah, Lagos

Job Summary
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	We’re looking to expand our  sales team with  results-driven sales representatives with excellent interpersonal skills to actively seek out and engage customer prospects at our Ajah Lagos Island Branch.


Job Description


	Present, promote and sell the company's products/services using solid sales pitch to existing and prospective customers
	Perform cost-benefit and needs analysis of existing/potential customers to meet their needs
	Establish, develop and maintain positive business and customer relationships
	Reach out to customer leads through calls, E-channels, social media and visits
	Expedite the resolution of customer problems and complaints to maximize satisfaction
	Achieve agreed upon sales targets and outcomes within schedule
	Coordinate sales effort with team members and other departments
	Analyze market potential, track sales and write status reports within catchment areas
	Supply management with reports on customer needs, problems, interests, competitive activities, and potential for new products and services.
	Awareness of best practices and promotional trends
	Continuously improve through feedback.


Requirements


	Experience in sales and an understanding of the sales process and dynamics would be an added advantage
	Honesty and  Integrity
	The ability to drive and possession of a current drivers license would be an added advantage.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should email their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as subject of the email.

Job Position: Account Officer

Job Locations: Abuja (FCT) and Sabon Wuse - Niger
Employment Type: Full-time
Department: Accounts / Finance

Job Summary

The successful candidate will assist with financial record-keeping, transaction processing, account reconciliation, and the preparation of financial reports to support the organization's financial operations.
	


Key Responsibilities


	Maintain accurate financial records, accounts, and supporting documents.
	Record daily financial transactions, including payments, receipts, and expenses.
	Prepare and process invoices, payment vouchers, and other accounting documents.
	Reconcile bank statements, cash records, and ledger accounts.
	Monitor accounts payable and receivable and ensure timely processing of transactions.
	Assist in preparing periodic financial reports and account statements.
	Ensure proper filing and documentation of financial records.
	Monitor expenses and support budget tracking.
	Assist with audits and provide relevant financial documents when required.
	Ensure compliance with company policies, accounting procedures, and financial regulations.
	Perform other accounting and administrative duties as assigned.


Requirements and Qualifications


	Bachelor's degree or HND in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
	Relevant experience in an accounting or finance role is an advantage.
	Good knowledge of basic accounting principles and financial record-keeping.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
	Familiarity with accounting software is an added advantage.
	Strong numerical, analytical, and organizational skills.
	High level of accuracy, integrity, confidentiality, and attention to detail.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
